As the main-text displays are accepted, we'll gather the supporting material
readers need to inspect them more closely: model registries, diagnostics,
pairwise comparisons, any additional Douglas-fir detail, expanded fuel
components, and machine-readable phase-specific values. Each item should be
linked from the result it supports so the supplement extends the main text
without making it harder to follow.
